Cash Flow & Profit Enhancement
Successfully recovered THB 51.2 million from long -outstanding receivables after extensive negotiations, strengthening liquidity 
and contributing to higher net profit in Y2025
Strategic Resource Expansion
Acquired Boonthavorn Mining (BTV) for THB 212.8 million, securing 24.21 million tons of limestone reserves with a 25 -year 
remaining concession to support long -term production growth.
Project Financing Secured
Successfully secured THB 108 million in long -term loan facilities, together with equipment leasing facilities, to support the 
construction and development of the Khao Yoiquarry project.
New Quarry Development Milestone
Executed a turnkey -contract with an experienced vendor for the development of the Khao YoiQuarry, ensuring reliable 
equipment performance and operational efficiency. The project is progressing toward commercial operation (COD) within 2026 .
